item.title: Heart surgeon warns about most harmful kind of body fat: ‘It lives deep in our bellies’
item.description: Visceral fat, the deep abdominal fat surrounding vital organs, poses greater health risks than subcutaneous fat. A cardiothoracic surgeon explains how it drives inflammation, raises metabolic disease risk and what simple steps can help reduce it.
